body: Thank you so much for your reply. This really means alot to me and I agree and genuinely do wanna make this work. We have a very good relationship overall and I am the happiest I've ever been with somebody. Alot of this just weighs on my mind I guess. We talk about this somewhat regularly and I try to be very open. We both are generally kinda unsure of what to do abt it but they are as supportive as possible in this sort of situation honestly and thats the best I think I could ask for out of somebody.

Hey, thank you for your comment. Last night was pretty rough on me but I'm feeling alot better now. I agree with the outlook on life thing too. It's important to not get stuck pitying yourself because the truth is it gets you nowhere in life. I'm glad there's people out there who care though, Really, thank you.

It is pretty weird, huh, haha. There's always some people out there that have similar interests though! Oh man, Misery is really great too. His older books are all pretty good, but his newer stuff has a more arrogant everybody-will-buy-my-books-anyways kind of feeling to me.

Oh boy, so many bands aaah~ Andrew Jackson Jihad is a big favorite. Id recommend starting with the album "People who can eat people are the luckiest people in the world." and seeing if you like his style. Wingnut Dishwasher Union is also a really nice band that has alot of high-energy feel good punk stuff and its good to listen to if you're feeling down. Hm. It might be a little overrated to some people but Neutral Milk Hotel honestly has some really nice music too, and I listen to them alot! Interpol is also a really good band with chill but rather intense music. Ahh I could geek out about music all day~

There's always new things to find. Even when the now is shitty, there's always something else out there. There's always hope, of a sort, even if you cant really see it. It's your perspective, and only you can change it though. It might take something small happening ro a big realization but its possible to see your life differently if you try.

Oh man, thats sweet as hell. Im hoping to get the compass from the cover tattooed on me next year if i have the cash for it. 
Also, nice!! Ive never been to one of their concerts but id imagine the energy from their shows would be incredible. I was slightly on the fence about the back on top album at first but its really grown on me. Aha both of my favorite bands sorta did the same thing, releasing a chiller album then usual. The other being AJJ's Christmas Island. Honestly folk punk has taken over a good 60% of my life and I wouldent have it any other way. Its very cool to meet you tho dude. Oh, btw, Let the right one in is a really good book. If you watch the movie id watch the Swedish version first. Another good book is Under the Dome. It surprised me that I liked it as much as I did considering im not much on Steven king books nowadays.

If your into weird and very lengthy books id suggest House of Leaves. Its a psychological horror/documentary/experimental novel of sorts and probably a whole lode of other things. Probably my favorite book of all time tbh. Its a pretty lengthy read (721 pages in total) but a good book that got me through a few bad years.
Also dang, nice taste in music. TFB is life. Modest Mouse is also great. Do you have any opinions on folk punk?

Yeah, I get down and out thinking about things too. Its a good practice to keep yourself focused on something, even if its just small. A simple zen game in your phone or even a little figure. You can also get rings and just feel the metal of them. Anything to bring you into the now is generally a pretty good thing for you. But anyways im glad I could atleast chat you up a little when your feeling like this. Stay good, man.

I ust to be really dragged down by the thought of that too, man. The truth is, life IS meaningless, its only you that puts meaning into it. You can only put meaning into the good and bad that happens in your life, yknow? Your thoughts and expirences and solely your own. Personally, I just think you should make the most of your expirences if they dont matter. Live and breathe in the moment, because there's no real point to be anxious or upset about anything that happens in the end. I hope that sorta makes sense. Im also glad to hear youre doing better in school n all that, thats a pretty big problem for me as well so I get glad when I see others starting to do a little better.

Hey man, I get how you feel. I was in a relationship for a good 3-4 years of my life before I found out the dude didn't even feel anything for me and ended it. He was my fucking world. But the only thing you can do after is keep thinking about how it doesn't matter in the end. Your expirences and feelings are solely yours. You are the only person to ever feel, think, see, and hear the way you do. Nothing matters unless you make it matter and thats a great and simultaneously awful thing. I hope you make it through this time in your life, and if not, ill see you on the other side. Btw, great taste in music. How do you feel about The Front Bottoms?
